package example.bankwealth.v2.infrastructure.bootstrap

import akka.actor.typed.ActorSystem
import akka.actor.typed.scaladsl.adapter._
import akka.cluster.sharding.typed.scaladsl.ClusterSharding
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.FundQuotaAggregate
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.services.FundQuotaComputations
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.FundOrderAggregate
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.services.FundOrderComputations
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.aggregates.CreditBalanceAggregate
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.services.CreditBalanceComputations
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.readmodels.bank_order_readside.BankOrderReadsideProjectionHandler
import example.bankwealth.v2.application.readmodels.bank_order_readside.repository.BankOrderReadsideRepository
import javax.inject.{Inject, Singleton}
import play.api.{Application, ApplicationLoader}
import scala.concurrent.ExecutionContext
import scala.util.control.NonFatal
import BankwealthServiceContract._

/** Guice eager-singleton application bootstrap mounting all CQRS aggregates and projections. */
@Singleton
class ApplicationBootstrap @Inject()(
  classicSystem: akka.actor.ActorSystem,
  sharding: ClusterSharding,
  fundQuotaComputations: FundQuotaComputations,
  fundOrderComputations: FundOrderComputations,
  creditBalanceComputations: CreditBalanceComputations,
  bankOrderReadsideRepository: BankOrderReadsideRepository,
  bankOrderReadsideBindings: BankOrderReadsideProjectionHandler.Bindings
) extends FundQuotaBootstrap
  with FundOrderBootstrap
  with CreditBalanceBootstrap
  with BankOrderReadsideBootstrap {
  private implicit val system: ActorSystem[Nothing] = classicSystem.toTyped
  private implicit val ec: ExecutionContext = system.executionContext

  initFundQuotaAggregate(sharding, fundQuotaComputations)
  initFundOrderAggregate(sharding, fundOrderComputations)
  initCreditBalanceAggregate(sharding, creditBalanceComputations)
  initBankOrderReadsideProjection(
    system = system,
    readJournalPluginId = classicSystem.settings.config.getString("akka.persistence.query.journal.id"),
    tags = FundQuotaAggregate.tags ++ FundOrderAggregate.tags ++ CreditBalanceAggregate.tags,
    repository = bankOrderReadsideRepository,
    bindings = bankOrderReadsideBindings
  )
}

object ApplicationBootstrap {
  def load(context: ApplicationLoader.Context): Application = {
    BankwealthServiceConfiguration.validate(context.initialConfiguration)
    val factory = context.environment.classLoader.loadClass("example.bankwealth.v2.modules.BootstrapModule").getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance().asInstanceOf[Factory]
    require(factory.implementation == "example.bankwealth.v2.modules.BootstrapModule" && factory.version == "v2-service-1", "composition factory pin mismatch")
    val composition = factory.create(context)
    try {
      requireInstalled(composition)
      new BankwealthServiceComponents(context, composition).application
    } catch { case NonFatal(error) =>
      context.lifecycle.stop()
      composition.close()
      throw error
    }
  }
}
